# legacy2mcp

> legacy2mcp analyzes a local Python or JavaScript/TypeScript codebase (business flows, per-flow risk, proposed MCP tools, agent topology, roadmap) and turns approved flows, a legacy SOAP/WSDL service, a database (Postgres, SQL Server, or Oracle), or a REST API into a typed, schema-validated, audit-logged MCP (Model Context Protocol) server, with no hand-written adapter code.

## Core capabilities

- Codebase analysis (`legacy2mcp analyze`): static, local, no API key. Parses Python (stdlib ast) and JS/TS (tree-sitter); finds Flask/FastAPI/Django/Express/Next.js routes, CLI commands, jobs and queue consumers; traces each business flow through the call graph; labels it read-only, low-risk write or high-risk (payments, deletes, external sends, auth changes) with file:line reasons; writes one offline HTML report plus analysis.json. Optional bring-your-own-key AI enrichment (Anthropic or OpenAI) sends redacted structure only, after a preview and confirmation.
- `legacy2mcp generate`: turns tools approved in the report into a runnable `type: rest` server config; write tools stay hidden unless explicitly allowed.

- SOAP: introspects a live WSDL with `zeep` and builds a JSON Schema per operation; every call is validated against it before it reaches the SOAP endpoint.
- Database: introspects a live Postgres/SQL Server/Oracle schema and exposes `select_<table>` / `insert_<table>` tools for an explicit table allowlist, plus named parameterized queries. There is no path from the LLM to arbitrary SQL, ever.
- REST: builds tools from an explicit endpoint allowlist, either hand-written or generated by `legacy2mcp init` (which can discover a live OpenAPI/Swagger spec from a URL, or statically scan a GitHub repo's routes/models).
- Write-like operations (SOAP write-verb names, DB inserts, non-GET REST endpoints) are excluded by default and require `allow_write_operations: true` set explicitly.
- Every tool call is audit-logged as one JSON line (tool, arguments, timestamp, outcome). Arguments are logged as-is: no PII redaction and no encryption at rest yet.

## Install and run

```bash
pip install "legacy2mcp[analyze]"
legacy2mcp analyze ./my-app --no-ai          # offline report: flows, risk, tools, roadmap
legacy2mcp generate legacy2mcp-analysis --selections selections.json --base-url https://staging.example.com

pip install legacy2mcp
legacy2mcp init --rest-url "https://your-api.example.com" --out config.yaml   # or --wsdl-url / --github-url
legacy2mcp inspect --config config.yaml   # review the generated tools
legacy2mcp run     --config config.yaml   # start the MCP server (stdio)
```

- [README](https://github.com/OWASP/legacy2mcp/blob/main/README.md): install, quick start, full config reference for all three adapters, safety model
- [Codebase analysis guide](https://github.com/OWASP/legacy2mcp/blob/main/docs/analyze.md): analyze, report, generate, AI enrichment and privacy
- [Sample report](https://github.com/OWASP/legacy2mcp/tree/main/docs/sample-report): real output from an open-source Flask app
- [Security model](https://github.com/OWASP/legacy2mcp/blob/main/docs/security.md): exactly what's validated and audited today, and what isn't yet
- [Roadmap](https://github.com/OWASP/legacy2mcp/blob/main/docs/roadmap.md): shipped vs. planned
- [Examples](https://github.com/OWASP/legacy2mcp/blob/main/examples/README.md): runnable SOAP and REST demo configs
- [Connecting MCP clients](https://github.com/OWASP/legacy2mcp/blob/main/docs/clients.md): Claude Desktop, Claude Code, Cursor, VS Code
